title: REQ · Scene is built from content into entities on ordered layers
summary: A generic scene builder turns SceneDef objects into layered display entities.
description: Context: SceneDef objects carry asset, position, scale and layer (content/schema.ts layerSchema: background, furniture, objects, characters, effects, ui). No code creates display objects from them. Desired behavior: a layer-order module plus an entity class and generic buildScene create one entity per visible object, at the content position and scale, with depth from the layer. Expected: bedroom.yaml objects render without any per-object code. Why: adding an object is a content edit.
acceptance_criteria: Given objects on layers background to ui, when buildScene runs, then depths are strictly increasing in the order background, furniture, objects, characters, effects, ui
Given an ObjectDef with position and scale, when built, then the display handle is placed at that position with that scale
Given an object whose visibleWhen fails, when built, then no entity is created for it
Given a new object appended to scene content, when built, then an entity exists without any engine code change
technical_constraints: No object ids hardcoded in engine code
